productization.list_data_performance_na_reason: Single-page registration form with no list, pagination, or large-dataset rendering scope.

summary_comment: The output clearly satisfies the frozen task: a React form calls a mock remote API, blocks submit until async username validation succeeds, and supports correction after server-side invalid/error paths with debouncing, aborts, stale-response guards, and idempotent submit keys. Layout and feedback are generally polished, but the empty-state “Go to display name” control focuses the username field instead of display name (also diverges from PLAN.md), and there are no automated tests despite test-friendly mocks.
